title: Yellowed Chewy Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A funky and chewy Moroccan dish featuring lamb, tomato ketchup, and a blend of spices, cooked in a tagine vessel on a robata grill, paleo-friendly and perfect for a dinner meal.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper into a smooth paste.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tomato ketchup, olive oil, and the spice paste.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Transfer the lamb to a tagine vessel and add the chopped onion.
Cover the tagine and cook for an additional 20 minutes, or until the onion is caramelized and the lamb is tender.
Serve the lamb hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
